name: Uzuki Rina
source:
Shion and Kanon’s maternal cousin.
Her family lives far away, and she is staying with the Yuzaki family to attend university.

While attending university, she also works as a magazine model. She’s sharp and composed while at school or work, but at home, she becomes lazy and slovenly. (And Kanon often scolds her for being a hindrance to cleaning.)

She is good at talking and gets along well with others, serving as a mood maker both at home and at university. People naturally gather around her.
She respects Shion, who supports the shop solidly despite being of a similar age, but she is concerned about Shion’s tendency to take on burdens alone.
